_comment: Fleet onboarding manifest. The agent's first-run onboard_thread maps the share and runs the generated batch (onboard.cmd on NT/XP, onboard_9x.bat on Win98 -- BOTH produced from THIS file by gen_onboard.py). Edit the game list here, regenerate, then publish to the share. Each game is a single ZIP on the share, extracted with the JScript Shell.Application shim (NOT xcopy - xcopy hangs on NETMAP'd SMB on XP; see CLAUDE.md). Paths marked NEEDS-VERIFY are best-effort until confirmed on a live machine.
_requires_comment: Each game's 'requires' lists capability flags the machine must have for the game to be COPIED. The agent detects the box's hardware (onboard.c) and sets ONB_<FLAG>=1/0 env vars before running the batch; a game whose required flags aren't all met is skipped with [HWSKIP] (NOT counted as a failure, so the box still marks Onboarded). Flags: gpu3d = a 3D-accelerated display adapter (3dfx/NVIDIA/ATI/Intel); cpufast = CPU family >= 6 (Pentium Pro/II/III/4+, i.e. NOT a plain Pentium 1); ram64 = >=64MB RAM; ram128 = >=128MB. A Pentium-1 box with 2D-only video (e.g. a Compaq Deskpro 2000) meets none of gpu3d/cpufast, so it correctly receives no games.
